attempts.hypothesis: Running requests in this workload predominantly schedule one decode token. Their instruction counts should have a stable base cost, with variation explained by existing block count and allocation or caching at block boundaries.

pcvs.name: existing_full_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Tracks sequence-dependent block bookkeeping during slot allocation and prefix caching.

pcvs.name: needs_new_block
pcvs.rationale: For the workload's single-token decode steps, a block-aligned entry requires allocating another KV block.

pcvs.name: completes_full_block
pcvs.rationale: Identifies decode steps that complete a block and can trigger prefix-cache registration.

attempts.hypothesis: All 52 observed calls stayed within one KV block without completing or allocating a block. Their costs may therefore be approximately constant; sequence length and running-request count distinguish workload states while allowing Dr. Perf to fit any residual dependence.

pcvs.name: sequence_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Provides varying entry states and captures any sequence-length-dependent allocation bookkeeping within the single-block regime.

pcvs.name: running_requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures batch-size-dependent scheduler and container costs.

attempts.hypothesis: Most states cost approximately 63,000 instructions; the two earliest short-sequence states are substantially higher. First decode of short prompts may proxy runtime specialization overhead. Conditional prompt length allows the elevated states to differ without imposing a length trend on steady-state calls.

pcvs.name: sequence_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Retains sequence-length variation across the observed workload.

pcvs.name: short_prompt_first_decode
pcvs.rationale: Tests whether the elevated costs belong to the first decode of short prompts, which occur during initial runtime specialization.

pcvs.expression: request.num_prompt_tokens if request.num_prompt_tokens < 16 and request.num_output_tokens == 1 else 0
pcvs.name: short_prompt_first_decode_length
pcvs.rationale: Allows length-dependent cost within the hypothesized initial decode regime.
